svg.text: Cloudflare One Managed Network Geo-Beacon Architecture — Mainland China Split-Tunnel Automation
Cloudflare One — WARP Endpoints & Zero Trust Edge

g.text: ✓ Google Meet bypasses tunnel (Direct to Google)
→ Probe rejected (TCP RST); stays on Office Profile
2. Switches Profile → Tunnel Includes Google Meet
• China Roaming Users → Via Cloudflare Gateway

svg.text: Auto Scaling Group (min=1, max=1) Across 3 AZs (2a, 2b, 2c)
Active EC2 t4g.micro (Free Tier AL2023 ARM64 — IMDSv2)

g.text: (SYN dropped before TCP/TLS handshake for RoW/AU)
• Zero Header/Body Parsing; Strips Server Banners
• Persists TLS keypair across ASG failovers
• Preserves SHA-256 thumbprint in Cloudflare One
• Zero private keys stored in Terraform state
